answer: Use a single-use Merkle claim registry bridged to each chain by an attestation bridge: every new address must present a Merkle proof of one unused human claim, countersigned by a quorum of three notaries, and each claim is nulled on first use, so it can never back a second account. A 1,000-account farm must buy 1,000 attestations at 30 USDC each from three notaries (90,000 USDC), fund 1,000 signatures, and wait four hours for quorum rotation; replaying one claim hits a burned leaf. Farming is like a thousand stakes in mud: the tide arrives once, and the timber rots before it holds.
